display_name: Venus ruler of the 1st House in the 1st House
description: You are the magnet. Slow, deliberate, sensual presence is your operating system. Rushed days misfire; the body wants steady tempo, the room wants the considered move. Honor the comfort, but do not let it stagnate. Build daily rituals — body care, beauty, taste, simple repeated pleasures. The shadow: comfort-trap. display_name: Saturn ruler of the 10th House in the 10th House

display_name: Saturn ruler of the 9th House in the 10th House

display_name: Jupiter ruler of the 11th House in the 11th House

display_name: Jupiter ruler of the 8th House in the 11th House
description: Sudden transformations route through the wide friend-network. display_name: Moon ruler of the 3rd House in the 3rd House

Sibling-channel and peer-channel rapport carry your week — invest in them. The shadow: emotional reactivity in the message. When the day is hot, sleep before sending the bold note.

display_name: Sun ruler of the 4th House in the 4th House

The shadow: paternal projection coloring choices that should be yours alone — see the inherited expectation, then choose freely.

display_name: Mercury ruler of the 2nd House in the 5th House
description: Speak less, write more. The voice carries weight when it has been preceded by considered language. Family-money topics are best handled as creative projects — the spreadsheet treated like the script — and the household responds to careful documentation more than to spontaneous appeal.

display_name: Mercury ruler of the 5th House in the 5th House

Use writing, journaling, sharp planning — they will save you weeks. The shadow: over-mentalizing the moment that wants to be felt. Some hours stay non-verbal.

display_name: Mars ruler of the 12th House in the 7th House
